text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While doing some research in the library,
I hear a
sad voice...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I... can't save you all... I'm so sorry. Not
even
flowers are safe from my bad luck...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Awww... Wahhh! The flowers!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Rice Shower is growing
flowers, but
the heatwave this year has
her worried that they'll
quickly wilt.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
They'd finally bloomed... But then I had
to get
involved and screw up the
weather!
U-um...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Rob Roy?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for eavesdropping, but there's
a
magazine I think you should read.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hm? A special feature about preserved
flowers?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, it's a way to keep fresh
flowers
looking beautiful for longer.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The colors stay vibrant and the flowers
bloom
forever! It's like something from a
fairy tale!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...So doing this keeps the flowers
beautifully in
bloom?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Rob Roy! I'm going to give this a
try!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
In that case, why don't we go to a flower

preserving class? The back of the
magazine
mentions one!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One of the conditions of the class is that

attendees are supervised by an adult, so
they ask
me to go along with them.

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Before flowers can be preserved, they
must be
raised to peak bloom. Then we
can begin the
decolorization and
dehydration processes in
order to
extract the matter that causes wilting.

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Today, our lesson begins following the

completion of those steps, meaning this
is where
we get into processing the
flowers!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
O-okay! I'll do my best for my precious
flowers!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
This is the solution that keeps the
flowers looking
beautiful... I need to be
very careful with it!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Warm it up in the microwave to body

temperature...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: BOOM!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Eek?! Th-the solution exploded
everywhere!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Awww, I have to remake the whole thing
again!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
My pretty, pretty flowers, stay beautiful
and fair!
Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It looks like you're casting a spell on
them.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: H-huh? R-really?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
My pretty, pretty flowers, stay beautiful
and fair!
Be bright, shiny, and cuter than
I can bear!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-I did it!

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Great job! Now you should take them
home and
leave them to dry for two
days.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Now I can keep my flowers looking
gorgeous!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Now I can keep my flowers looking
gorgeous!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah! I'll try my best to preserve them

perfectly!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'd love for you to see them too, Rob
Roy. My
flowers and I are in your debt,
after all...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Absolutely! I'm looking forward to
seeing the
lasting beauty of your
magical flowers.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Rob Roy. Let's decorate our
room with
them when they're done!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I've gotta make sure I review what
we did
today when I get home so I don't
forget!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'll help out too! I really think I've got
the knack
now!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Thanks, Rob Roy! I'm gonna do my best!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As she pictures her flowers, a smile full
of hope
and kindness spreads across
Rice Shower's face.
